subject: Commercial Exception Request: Onboarding Floor Credit for CardioPulse
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cardiopulse.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardiopulse.io
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial questions ahead of pilot kick-off

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Our Ops team is finalizing the pilot scope but we have a couple of constraints that will materially change usage patterns in month 1: bursty batch jobs from device data (spike windows) and a 3x higher token volume during onboarding due to extensive provenance traces. That pushes our expected Q1 spend above the standard onboarding floor.

We have a preferred purchasing cadence (single PO + quarterly invoicing) and would like to request a one-time onboarding floor credit to mitigate the ramp. Can Redwood offer a limited credit that covers up to 60% of expected overage in month 1, with standard consumption after that? If we can get that carveout, procurement will sign the MSA this week.

Attached the draft MSA and a usage forecast. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Product
CardioPulse

[Attachment: CardioPulse_MSA_v1.2.pdf] [Attachment: CP_onboarding_usage_forecast_Q1-Q4.xlsx]

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:03:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial questions ahead of pilot kick-off

Thanks Elaine — I can do that. I'm looping in internal approvals to get a one-time onboarding floor credit cleared. Will confirm the exact quantum and any obligations (measurement window / clawback) by EOD.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:02 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CardioPulse — request for one-time onboarding credit (business case attached)

Team — forwarding CardioPulse ask. Short ask: they want a one-time credit covering up to 60% of Month 1 overage driven by onboarding spikes (see forecast). If we approve, procurement signs this week and they commit to a 12-month starter package (tiered). Key points in support:
- High strategic fit: CardioPulse is a device-first vendor planning to standardize on our hosted API for inference at the edge and cloud aggregation.
- Expansion likelihood: Forecasted growth to $1.2M ARR across 18 months if pilot succeeds.
- Risk mitigation: We can limit the credit to known onboarding window (first 30 days) and require usage reporting with a simple clawback if they exceed forecasted sustained usage.

Attached a one-pager summarizing the proposed exception and the forecast. Need VP/CFO clearance for a >50% one-time credit outside standard guardrails.

Asks:
1) Marcus — can you sign off on >50% concession for onboarding once you review the one-pager?
2) Marissa / Finance — confirm billing cadence changes (single PO + quarterly invoicing) are acceptable from a collections & rev recognition perspective.

I can be on the approval call if helpful.

-- Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:11:27 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: CardioPulse — request for one-time onboarding credit (business case attached)

Jordan / Marcus — reviewed the one-pager and forecast. Finance ops is ok with single PO + quarterly invoicing provided we include:
- Clear milestone-based invoicing triggers in the SOW (pilot acceptance + milestone 30/60/90).
- A capped credit amount and a documented clawback clause tied to measured month-1 usage metrics.
- Recognition: we will treat the credit as contra-revenue and amortize against the pilot month; need revenue ops ticket to track.

Commercial note: >50% concession is outside the standard guardrail and requires Marcus + VP Sales approval. If Marcus signs, I'll prepare the commercial exception memo for CFO review.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commercial_exception_onepager.docx]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:02:50 -07:00
Subject: RE: CardioPulse — request for one-time onboarding credit (business case attached)

Appreciate the summary. High-level guidance: I am willing to approve a one-time onboarding credit up to 55% of the expected month-1 overage under these conditions:
1) The credit is time-limited to the onboarding window (30 days from go-live) and cannot be applied to ongoing consumption.
2) We include a clawback if sustained usage in months 2–3 exceeds the forecasted run-rate by >30%.
3) Procurement signs the full MSA and a 12-month minimum commitment (non-cancellable for the first 90 days).
4) Finance (Marissa) confirms accounting treatment and collections guardrails.

If Marissa confirms finance operationally and legal updates the SOW clause language, I'll prepare the memo for CFO signoff. Marcus
